text: When the queen arrived, she was shown a throne. "Is your throne like this?" She said: "It is as though it were it."
Then she was told to enter the palace. When she saw it, she thought it was deep water.
But it was "a palace made smooth with glass."
Her throne carried in a blink. A palace of glass over water. And a king who gave everything to Allah.
And the queen, who used to bow to the sun, said:
"My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Sulaiman to Allah, Lord of the worlds."
She did not submit to Sulaiman, alayhis salaam. She submitted with him, to Allah.
A letter, a gift sent back, and a grateful heart: that is how a queen turned from the sun to her Creator.
